review_evidence: This review unit covers the NASALib Bernstein, LTL, Tarski, co_structures, extended_nnreal, fault_tolerance, float, and reals primary subtrees.

NASALib README identifies the repository as a decades-long PVS formal-development library with about 38,000 proven formulas across 62 top-level libraries, and documents these named libraries as formal mathematical/formal-methods developments.

The immediately preceding NASALib source review directly inspected representative .pvs theories and .prf proof scripts and established that both formats carry formal definitions/statements/proofs; deprecated/example naming is not used as a hard-exclusion proxy.
summary: Retain all primary files in this NASALib partition: they comprise Bernstein/Tarski reasoning, temporal logic, coalgebraic structures, fault tolerance, floating-point arithmetic, and real analysis; no source-inspected lossless non-formal subset was identified.
